atmosphere: A narrow passage between raw concrete walls, lit by a single high slit of light that casts one sharp, deliberate shadow on uneven stone slabs — quiet, intentional, and stripped of all but the essential gesture.
material_language: Unfinished concrete with subtle asymmetrical fissures, paired with rough-hewn stone slabs whose irregular edges catch light differently; texture is honest, unpolished, and scale-appropriate to human movement.
lighting_intent: A single oblique light source from high right creates one crisp shadow shaped like a raised lever handle, anchoring the narrative in physical causality without revealing the object that casts it.

narrative_elements.element: A precise shadow in the shape of a raised lever handle, cast across stone slabs
narrative_elements.reason: L’ombre portée nette, projetée par un rayon oblique sur les dalles, répète la forme de la poignée relevée de la gourde noire et suggère le geste de boire sans effort.

narrative_elements.element: An asymmetrical wall junction where one surface tilts inward at fifteen degrees
narrative_elements.reason: It creates a controlled visual lead toward the product zone while avoiding template repetition, supporting the story’s suspended moment between activities.
